info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage QR Payment Requests API
info.description: The Manage QR Payment Requests API allows businesses to update the details of existing QR payment requests efficiently. This API supports operations that enable modifications to attributes such as payment amount, recipient details, and expiration settings. It is particularly useful for payment processors and merchants who need to adjust requests dynamically in response to changing transaction requirements or customer interactions. Developers can integrate this API to enhance their payment workflows and improve transaction management for their customers.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific QR payment request identified by its unique ID. Make the necessary changes to the payment request data as required and send the request to update it in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the status or details of a specific QR payment request identified by the given ID. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the specified schema to facilitate a successful update.

expiresAt.description: The expiration time of the payment request in ISO 8601 format.

requestContext.description: Contextual information regarding the payment request.
